name: Salmon Bake
directions: Mix rice with the rice wine vinegar and sugar. Set aside
lather salmon with oil and season on both sides with the garlic, paprika, onion powder and salt and pepper
Place salmon in the airfryer for 15-20 minutes at 390° F
In the meantime, cut imitation crab into small bite size pieces and mix it in with the mayo and sriracha
Add in the cream cheese to the mixture and hot salmon into the bowl. Mix until well incorporated
In a glass baking dish, place rice mixture and smush into a flat layer and add a generous amount of furikake on top
Scoop crab-salmon mixture on top and flatten
Bake for 15-17 minutes until the top layer is golden
Once out of the oven, add a generous sprinkle of furikake, add some mayo and sriracha on top. Serve with seaweed sheets.
